headline: Kenya Revenue Authority Waives Sh64.4 Billion in Tax Penalties
summary: The Kenya Revenue Authority provided Sh64.39 billion in tax penalty and interest waivers to nearly one million taxpayers under its ongoing amnesty initiative.
why: The KRA is Kenya's national tax collection body responsible for public revenue enforcement.

impacts.name: Kenya
impacts.why: Kenya Revenue Authority granted Sh64.4 billion in tax relief to local taxpayers.
